Groesbeck Investment Management Upped Its Lam Resh Com Com (LRCX) Holding by $516,304; High Pointe Capital Management Cut Apple (AAPL) Stake by $837,226 as Market Value Declined
May 27, 2018 - By Stephen Andrade
Groesbeck Investment Management Corp increased its stake in Lam Resh Corp Com Com (LRCX) by 21.92% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Groesbeck Investment Management Corp bought 2,806 shares as the company’s stock rose 8.53% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 15,606 shares of the industrial machinery and components company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.87M, up from 12,800 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Groesbeck Investment Management Corp who had been investing in Lam Resh Corp Com Com for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $33.14B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.14% or $2.34 during the last trading session, reaching $202.03. About 2.11 million shares traded. Lam Research Corporation (NASDAQ:LRCX) has risen 58.54% since May 27, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 46.99% the S&P500.
